title: ATP (Around The Post)
style: viral electronic pop, 130 BPM, sports highlight anthem, slow-mo whoosh SFX, big drop chorus, stadium synth lead, hip hop drums, color-commentator interlude, male and female duet, crowd explosion samples, paddle-pop percussion, TikTok-ready hook, festival energy
lyrics:
[Intro — sports highlight horn, slow-mo whoosh]
Did you SEE that?
Did you SEE that?!
ATP. Around. The. Post.
[crowd explosion]

[Verse 1 — male lead, swagger flow]
She pulled me wide, I'm running for the line
Ball's by the post, the angle's looking fine
I don't go OVER, I go AROUND
Ball clips the corner, hits the deck without a sound

[Pre-Chorus — building energy]
Forget the net — go AROUND the post
Lower than the tape — that's how you ghost
The crowd goes wild, the partner goes nuts
ATP, baby — separates the players from the putts!

[Chorus — viral hook, easy to chant]
A-T-P, around the P-O-S-T
A-T-P, that's the shot they didn't see
Pulled me wide? That's a gift, you'll see
A-T-P, around the post for me!

[Verse 2 — female lead, fast and sharp]
They tried to jam me middle, I slid right and reset
Ball came back wider — you didn't see it yet
Paddle low, follow through, brush the side
Around the post she goes, on the OTHER team's pride!

[Pre-Chorus]
Forget the net — go AROUND the post
Lower than the tape — that's how you ghost
The crowd goes wild, the partner goes nuts
ATP, baby — separates the players from the putts!

[Chorus]
A-T-P, around the P-O-S-T
A-T-P, that's the shot they didn't see
Pulled me wide? That's a gift, you'll see
A-T-P, around the post for me!

[Bridge — slow, instructional]
You don't need to clear the net on this one
Below the tape is legal, son
Wider angle is the shot they hate
ATP, every time, don't hesitate

[Verse 3 — duet, fast, escalating]
[male] Pulls me wide!
[female] I'm running!
[male] Ball is curving!
[female] The post is coming!
[male] Don't go over!
[female] Don't go over!
[both] AROUND THE POST! AROUND THE POST!

[Final Chorus — full crowd, big drop]
A-T-P, around the P-O-S-T
A-T-P, that's the shot they didn't see
Pulled me wide? That's a gift, you'll see
A-T-P, around the post for me!

[Outro — color commentator]
That, ladies and gentlemen,
is why you don't pull her wide.
Around. The. POST.
